rv.q: With song and dance numbers like 'Welcome to Diversity Day', 'Goodbye Toby, You're The Worsty' and 'That's What She Said', the send-up combines the asides and straight-to-camera monologues of the TV show's 'mockumentary' style and the razzle-dazzle of musical theater with hilarious results.
I can honestly say every single one of the performers wow'ed the crowd.
